title: Error-Subspace Calibration for Multi-Task Model Merging
abstract: arXiv:2610.33483v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Model merging combines task-specific expert models into a single model without joint training on their original datasets, but often incurs a performance gap relative to the individual experts. Post-merging calibration can reduce this gap through task-specific representation alignment, but the alignment objective alone does not specify which feature directions to correct. We propose Error-Subspace Calibration (ESCal), a post-merging calibration framework that identifies low-dimensional error subspaces from weight differences between expert and merged models. At each intermediate block boundary, a bridge module projects the merged representation onto the next block's input-projection error subspace and maps these coordinates to an additive correction in the current block's output-projection error subspace. translated_title: 多任务模型合并的误差子空间校准
translated_abstract: 模型合并无需在其原始数据集上进行联合训练，即可将面向特定任务的专家模型组合成单个模型，但相对于各个专家模型往往会产生性能差距。合并后的校准可以通过任务特定的表示对齐来缩小这一差距，但仅靠对齐目标本身并不能指明应当修正哪些特征方向。我们提出误差子空间校准，这是一种合并后校准框架，它从专家模型与合并模型之间的权重差异中识别出低维误差子空间。在每个中间块的边界处，一个桥接模块将合并后的表示投影到下一个块的输入投影误差子空间上，并将这些坐标映射为当前块输出投影误差子空间中的加性修正。由于子空间基保持固定，校准只需学习这些线性映射，从而形成一种参数高效的机制，用于特征修……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出误差子空间校准（ESCal）框架，从专家模型与合并模型的权重差异中提取低维误差子空间，并在各模块边界用固定基上的轻量线性桥接映射对合并模型的表示进行加性修正，以参数高效的方式缩小多任务模型合并后的性能差距。
en_tdlr: ESCal is a parameter-efficient post-merging calibration framework that identifies low-dimensional error subspaces from expert-vs-merged weight differences and applies lightweight linear bridge corrections at block boundaries, narrowing the performance gap of multi-task model merging.
